hook: FIFTY *YEARS TOGETHER. NOW THE BED IS *HALF EMPTY.
title: F40 · dada_ji · His Side of the Bed
lines: Fifty-one years of mornings. Then one morning, not.
People say, He had a full life. As if that makes the bed smaller.
People say, "He had a full life." As if that makes the bed smaller.
Some mornings she is angry at him for going first.
She cannot climb to the roof any more. So that morning, the one on the roof came down.
He did not tell her it was all right.
He knew what it is to carry someone long after they are gone.
They sat together until the tea went cold.
Then she drank her cup. And gave the second to the tulsi.
Grief is love with nowhere to go. Give it somewhere. That is sadhana.
